name: Top Eminent Healthcare Group Limited
summary: Top Eminent Healthcare Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides leveraged foreign exchange, trading, cash dealing, and other services. It offers commodity and index trading, and margin dealing services, as well as precious metals trading and settlement services. The company also provides securities brokerage and management services. It primarily operates in Hong Kong, New Zealand, Australia, and the People's Republic of China. The company was formerly known as KVB Kunlun Financial Group Limited and changed its name to Top Eminent Healthcare Group Limited in November 2019. Top Eminent Healthcare Group Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Top Eminent Healthcare Group Limited is a subsidiary of Citic Securities Overseas Investment Company Limited.
